correctness.rationale: The vertex list has a known odd-cycle criterion, independently checked via constraint ranks. Direct sign-wise Gaussian argmax classification yields all q_k and alpha_n cone probabilities and hence the exact sum-of-squares collision. Two explicit Gaussian exponential-moment bounds with rho=0.523156 and m=0.668102 prove n(0.9)^n error, and a sign-support coupling plus total-variation contraction proves the conditional binomial law. The submitted verifier confirms 1500 independent LP objectives and Monte Carlo class frequencies. These tests do not serve as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: An entire infinite family of exponentially many Gaussian normal cones is evaluated as an explicit support-size spectrum, with exponentially small deviation from uniform vertex exposure, sharp two-direction collision probability and binomial collision-support law. These are natural intrinsic angular statistics absent from known vertex enumeration, Ehrhart and enclosing-ball results, and establish a meaningful comparison between worst-case contact geometry and typical random-objective behavior.
